title: fix: bundled dust cleanup — docs
body:
## Bundled dust

Single-file documentation / comment fixes with no behavior change, grouped under the `docs` subsystem (stale or contradictory statements in AGENTS.md / jobspec headers maintained by the gardener's agents-update).

- #1942 - `architect/AGENTS.md`: Round-robin step 5 says the last-seen marker is PATCHed every iteration; `architect-run.sh` only updates it when the opus dispatch succeeds (`_OPUS_DISPATCH_FAILED` false).
- #1941 - `architect/AGENTS.md`: Write-permission contract lists only PATCH body / POST comments / close; `publish_draft` also commits the pitch file via the contents API (`pitch_pr_put`) on decompose and, since #1940, on q_and_a.
- #1937 - `supervisor/AGENTS.md`: claims the edge entrypoint runs a supervisor loop; `docker/edge/entrypoint-edge.sh` never calls `supervisor-run.sh` - only `docker/agents/entrypoint.sh` does.
- #1928 - `lib/AGENTS.md`: says `sprint-filer.sh` is invoked by `.woodpecker/ops-filer.yml`; that pipeline was removed in #779. The script requires only `FORGE_FILER_TOKEN`.

## Affected files

- architect/AGENTS.md
- architect/architect-run.sh
- supervisor/AGENTS.md
- lib/AGENTS.md

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `architect/AGENTS.md` round-robin step 5 states the last-seen marker is updated only on a successful opus dispatch.
- [ ] `architect/AGENTS.md` write-permission contract and `architect/architect-run.sh` header include the contents-API pitch commit.
- [ ] `supervisor/AGENTS.md` no longer attributes a supervisor loop to the edge entrypoint.
- [ ] `lib/AGENTS.md` sprint-filer row reflects the post-#779 invocation and env vars.
